_comment: SHA-256 of the binaries this build is allowed to run, and where each came from. Written by scripts/make-binaries-manifest.mjs. The two come from DIFFERENT upstream trees; see PROVENANCE.md beside this file.

zebrad.upstream_base: tag v6.3.0, the official Zcash Foundation release
zebrad.changes_vs_upstream: one file added: .github/workflows/swarm-binaries.yml (CI only). No Rust source, no Cargo.toml, no Cargo.lock.

miner.upstream_base: 7c64a8419388dd72664a19a70aed66e84f3e2d5b, a later upstream Zebra development commit 333 commits ahead of v6.3.0 - NOT the v6.3.0 release
miner.changes_vs_upstream: four commits, seven files, all additions except Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock: zebrad/src/bin/privacy-miner.rs, zebrad/src/bin/swarm-keytool.rs (not bundled), two docs, and .github/workflows/swarm-tools.yml. No existing source file is modified.
miner.build: cargo build --locked --release --package zebrad --bin privacy-miner --bin swarm-keytool --features internal-miner

_note: The node is v6.3.0; the miner is built from a tree 333 commits later. The miner is an RPC client: the node validates every block it accepts, so the node decides. Recorded, not smoothed over. See PROVENANCE.md.
